Marmoset 0.5 µm Mosaic Plan
Marmoset brain · scan plan

Mosaic scanning geometry

Background images are the existing 1.9 µm reconstruction (scans 180–186), binned to 61 µm. Each horizontal position is a 360° off-axis scan that covers one annulus around the rotation axis; vertical levels stack the annuli along the brain. Tiles and numbers update with the settings.

Vertical slices through the rotation axis

Horizontal slices: top, middle, bottom

Angular step around the rotation

Step for each ring of one level, relative to the uniform Nyquist step p/R. Higher means sparser. Blank means no tissue in that ring's strip: frames are skipped and filled with flat. The 180–360° half repeats 0–180° wherever both halves record, so the fold pairs exact angles.
